title: Cell Biology and Genetics: Main Exam, 23 April 2025
school: School of Pure and Applied Sciences
instructions: ANSWER ALL THE QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ONLY TWO QUESTIONS IN SECTION B.

parts.text: Describe the contrast light microscope.
Outline cell theory.
What is a karyotype?
Distinguish between plant and animal cells.
What are the advantages and disadvantages of using a light microscope?

Magnification
Hypertonic solution
Haploid
Monohybrid cross
Cytology
The sequence of a strand of DNA is ATTGCCGTCG. If this strand serves as the template for DNA synthesis, what will be the sequence of the newly synthesized strand?

items.text: Section B ANSWER ONLY ONE QUESTION IN THIS SECTION

parts.text: Discuss in detail the classification of mutations.
Discuss in detail the process of mitosis.
On the basis of Mendel's observations, predict the results from the following crosses with peas. Clearly show your workings.
A tall (dominant and homozygous) variety crossed with a dwarf variety
The progeny of (i) self-fertilized
The progeny from (i) crossed with the original tall parent
The progeny of (i) crossed with the original dwarf parent
Describe in detail the process of phagocytosis.
